in_sanskrit.name: वालेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वाल (vala) - protector, ईश (Ish) - God. So, Balesh means 'The God who protects'.

in_hindi.name: बालेश
in_hindi.meaning: बाला (bala) - child, ईश (Ish) - God. So, Balesh means 'God of children' or 'God of infancy'.

in_tamil.name: வாலேஷ
in_tamil.meaning: வால் (val) - to protect, இஷ் (Ish) - God. So, Balesh means 'God who protects' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: బాలేశ
in_telugu.meaning: బాలు (bala) - child, ఈశ్ (Ish) - God. So, Balesh means 'God of children' or 'God of infancy' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Balesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's servant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Balesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bala' (Lord Vishnu) and 'Ish' (servant or god). This name is given to a boy born in a Hindu family, signifying his devotion and servitude to Lord Vishnu.
